name: vyro.submit_url
description: Vyro: submit a live post URL to a campaign you joined. Opens the campaign (app.vyro.com/campaigns?c=<id>) and clicks Submit post, which is disabled once payouts end. The form's fields are UNVERIFIED: they could only be written once a live, joined campaign exists to look at.

steps.note: Submit post (disabled when the campaign's payouts have ended)

steps.selector: [role=dialog] input[type=url], [role=dialog] input[placeholder*='link' i], [role=dialog] input[placeholder*='url' i], [role=dialog] textarea
